# Decision-ready Spec

Status: decision-ready
Mode: small

Decision: Where should the short guide live?

Choices: project repository | global Skills shelf

Recommendation: project repository, because this guide has one owner and no
cross-project behavior.

Consequence: Keeping it local makes ownership and updates explicit; moving it
to the global shelf would add review and distribution overhead without reuse.

Evidence: The guide has one named owner and one consumer. Source:
https://example.test/ownership, observed 2026-08-24. This is a fixture fact,
not an external claim.

Implementation status: not started; wait for owner authorization.
